diagnoses.description: No skill gives guidance for quickly reproducing the build/test environment (tox matrix, coverage-driven pytest, version-specific behavior) and selecting the right local reproduction method. The agent spent many tool calls creating ad-hoc venvs and hit avoidable pip/permission issues before seeing the real failing tests. This increases risk of MaxIterationsReached.

Skills do not remind the agent to consider global singleton state leaking across tests, or to validate fixes against the actual failing assertions and logs. The attempted idempotency change did not address the underlying request-count and tag behavior.

Skills do not enforce the required workflow to write failed_reasons.txt, create valid patch files, apply them, and rerun tests in a verifier-equivalent environment. The skill should require git apply --check and a final tox/coverage validation.
